extracted_text: FSTEC 2026 contacts met by Todd Vahlsing on September 23-25, 2026. This is not a registration roster and not the Genius User Conference campaign. Contacts: Jason Ross — H-E-B; Jose Merino — Pollo Campero USA; Roberto Morado Jr — Pollo Campero; Lucie Tuan — Wingstop Inc; Rich McDonald — Glory Global; Todd Stewart — A&W Restaurants; Weston Huggins — CEC Entertainment; Daniel Legh-Page — Torchy’s Tacos; Carrick Mollenkamp — Freestone Grove Partners. The PDF contains badge photographs and one additional photo of Todd with Jose Merino.
